title: Step 4 (third order after #834/#838 tool blocks; tool probe #842 passed): A0001/A0002 mutation controls in the library specialty scorer, settle scheme name (F2, F4)
body:
## Goal
Positive-control thread (#763 f4), step 4. #834 and #838 ordered this work and were blocked with nothing saved: their file tools returned "disabled for this session". Tool probe #842 (iteration 0196) showed every tool working in a benchmark session. First prove the tools work (one Read, one Grep); if they fail, write the report at once with the exact error text and stop.

Already settled, do not repeat: #828 F1 confirmed the artifact hash and the literals A0001 `20008000` at `/Library/@LVVersion` and A0002 `NI.LV.All.SourceOnly` at `/Library/Property[4]/@Name`. F3 is closed: `benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json` line 2513 sets `source.inventory_path` to `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json`. #831 read from code that `compute()` checks the literal by exact equality and the locator via `citation_support()` (grounding only), and that `regression_self_test` mutations target A0005 only.

Work: (1) add wrong-literal (one changed digit of A0001) and wrong-locator (A0002 at `Property[3]`) mutation controls for A0001 and A0002 next to the existing A0005 mutations, in the same style; (2) F4: read the citation dicts of A0001/A0002 in the inventory and state whether the scheme name `xpath-positional` vs `xml-positional-path` is part of the compared dict; align it in the inventory only if key and inventory disagree inside the compared dict; (3) regenerate `benchmark/results/challenges.json` with score.py; (4) update every pin of each changed file in the same task (#739/#766). Do not change the literals or the key file. Expected gain: the self-test shows A0001/A0002 controls fail on a wrong literal and a wrong locator; the next reviewer reads the mutation names and the results line.

No session can run LabVIEW; make no claim about how LabVIEW interprets any value.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Tool probe done first (one Read, one Grep); result in the report's first lines.
- [ ] Check `.session/exports/manifest.json` for the #828 and #831 reports; read `.session/inputs/828-pins.txt`.
- [ ] The scorer self-test contains wrong-literal and wrong-citation mutations for A0001 and for A0002, and each one is detected (output line quoted in the report).
- [ ] F4 answered with the exact inventory lines; any change is limited to the compared dict field.
- [ ] `benchmark/results/challenges.json` regenerated by score.py and parses as JSON; all pins of changed files updated, each listed with old and new SHA-256 in the report.
- [ ] Use `python3 -B` with `sys.dont_write_bytecode = True`; `git status --porcelain` shows only intended files and no `__pycache__`; do not run `git commit`.

## Verification
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json')); c=d['claims']; assert c['A0001']['value']=='20008000' and c['A0002']['value']=='NI.LV.All.SourceOnly'; f=json.load(open('benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json')); assert f['source']['inventory_path']=='benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json'; json.load(open('benchmark/results/challenges.json')); print('key, inventory path, results: OK')"

## Context
- #831 report: `generate()` hashes the inventory against `source.inventory_sha256`; changing the inventory requires updating that hash in the fixture.
- Bytecode trap (#785). Long inline python one-liners stall (#743): write helper scripts under `.session/artifacts/`.
- Tools were disabled mid-session in #828, #831, #834 and #838: write the report early and refine it; save each file as soon as it is done.

## Budget
Read: the #828 and #831 reports, `.session/inputs/828-pins.txt`, in `benchmark/scripts/score.py` only `regression_self_test`, `compute`, `citation_support`, `generate` (Grep first), the A0001/A0002 entries of `benchmark/cases/dev/library-specialty.json`, the `source` block of `benchmark/challenges/library-specialty.json` (around line 2513), `benchmark/challenges/positive-control-key-0191.json`. Grep for pins of changed files' hashes. Do not read `benchmark/results/**` or `journal/**` whole. Short command output only.

title: Changed-scope review of step 4: A0001/A0002 mutation controls, scheme name and pins
body:
## Goal
Independent changed-scope review of the step 4 task in this graph (positive-control thread, #763 f4). Report, do not fix: write no repository file. Expected gain: CLEAR or NOT-CLEAR on the first lines of `.session/report.md` that closes #828 F2/F4 and the step 4 change, so the next shaper can close the positive-control thread. If file tools fail, report the exact error at once and stop.

No session can run LabVIEW; make no claim about how LabVIEW interprets any value.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Confirm the key literals are unchanged and that every changed file's pins match the hashes you measured.
- [ ] Run the scorer self-test on a temporary copy of the tree outside the repository (`python3 -B`) and confirm each A0001/A0002 wrong-literal and wrong-citation mutation is detected; quote output lines.
- [ ] Judge the F4 answer against the inventory lines.
- [ ] Findings with severity in `.session/report.md`, detail in `.session/artifacts/review-0197.md`; `git status --porcelain` clean at the end.

## Verification

## Context

## Budget
